# Release artifacts

`arduino-stc51-<version>.tar.bz2` is generated by `scripts/package-platform.ps1` and is the immutable platform archive referenced by the Boards Manager package index. Compiler and wrapper-host tools are separate, checksum-pinned dependencies and are not copied into this archive.

The two `sdcc-mcs251-macos-<arch>-<commit>.tar.bz2` files are native Apple Silicon and Intel toolchain flavours built from the pinned `gevico/sdcc-c251` commit. Rebuild them on macOS with `scripts/build-macos-toolchain.sh`; exact provenance, byte sizes and SHA-256 values are recorded in `tools/toolchain-manifest.json`.
